settings.heading: 1. What is the Athena Pro Wuchang Edition Gaming Chair?
settings.content: The Athena Pro Wuchang Edition is a special gaming chair designed in collaboration with Wuchang: Fallen Feathers, inspired by the immersive game experience and visual storytelling of the title. It blends premium ergonomic support with Wuchang-themed aesthetics.

settings.heading: 2. What ergonomic features does the Wuchang Edition include?
settings.content: It features 4-way dynamic lumbar support, 4D adjustable armrests, a magnetic neck pillow, up to 149° recline with rocking, and Class-4 height adjustment—designed to keep you supported and comfortable during long gaming sessions.

settings.heading: 3. Who is this chair best for?
settings.content: It’s ideal for: Fans of Wuchang: Fallen Feathers; Gamers who appreciate themed gear and aesthetics; Players seeking ergonomic support for long play; Users who want both comfort and visual storytelling in their setup.

settings.heading: 4. What size and weight does the chair support?
settings.content: This limited-edition gaming chair is built to accommodate most users comfortably, recommended for users up to 330 lbs (150kg) and up to 6’2″ (190cm) tall, fitting most body types comfortably.

settings.heading: 5. Do I need to assemble the chair?
settings.content: Yes, basic assembly is required. The package includes clear instructions and tools, and most users can assemble the chair within about 15–30 minutes.

settings.heading: 6. Does the chair come with a warranty?
settings.content: The Athena Pro Wuchang Edition Gaming Chair comes with a 3-year gaming chair warranty as standard. By joining the Extend Warranty Program, coverage can be extended up to 5 years for added long-term protection.
